text_block_list.text:
While contemplating her motivation for
racing,
Уиннинг Тикит realizes that she
had lost sight of
her desire not to lose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She remembers that her dream was to
deliver the
best races to the audience by
winning each and
every one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having realized what truly matters, she's
grateful
to Бива Хаяхидэ and Narita
Taishin for helping
her understand that
and challenges them to a
scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Through the race, her two rivals
recognize that
the passionate Winning
Ticket they once knew
has finally
returned.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With that settled, the BNW trio will
meet again at
the most important race at
the end of the year,
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
